footnotes.text: “Organization of the Church in Italy,”Millennial Star,Dec. 15, 1850, 373.

The Only Way to Be Saved(pamphlet, 1841), 2–3; italics in original have been removed; punctuation has been standardized. Lorenzo Snow wrote this pamphlet eight years before his call to serve as an Apostle. It was later translated into other languages, including Italian, French, Dutch, Danish, German, Swedish, Bengali, Turkish Armenian, and Turkish Greek. It was reprinted from time to time throughout the rest of the 1800s, during his ministry as an Apostle.
